purpose: strongest fully public arithmetic high-generic-rank fallback currently reproduced in this repository

construction.parameters: p=t^2(8+3t^2), q=-6(2+t^2)(4+t^2), and the displayed rational u(t)
construction.roots: b_i=u+a_i and b_(i+6)=-u+a_i for the six displayed a_i(p,q)
construction.points: P1,...,P12 have (x,y)=(b_i,G(b_i)); the source gives the abscissas of P13,P14,P15 and uses P15 as origin

certificate_specialization.claim: P1,...,P14 are independent with P15 as origin
certificate_specialization.repository_method: exact full-rank finite-reduction certificate modulo 5, followed by infinite descent

generic_implication: The source supplies the points over Q(t). Their exact independence after the defined t=2 specialization rules out any relation over Q(t).

source.citation: S. Kihara, On an elliptic curve over Q(t) of rank >= 14, Proc. Japan Acad. Ser. A Math. Sci. 77 (2001), 50-51

caution: This is a reproduced rank-at-least-14 family baseline. It supplies no rank-30 candidate, no fifteenth point independent of the displayed fourteen, and no conductor-optimized specialization.
